acceptanceCriteria: prepare runs only while the member is quarantined.
Pending replay never re-executes a completed prepare.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1009 (author ls-russell-lewis, opened 2026-10-17). Feature request; not yet specified. Re-seeding shared data after a member reset is paid by the first holder. Proposal: memberConfig.prepare (same bounded runner and digest-only output as health/cleanup) run by pool sweep while the member is still quarantined; failure leaves it quarantined with a recorded reason. Related: V1-0695 (safe-reuse check), V1-0857 (cleanup bounds). See beamfall/corvint#1009 for the full problem, current workaround and proposal.
title: corvint-tasks pool sweep: optional memberConfig prepare step after cleanup and health, before the member is freed (issue #1009)
